provenance.limits: Separate-assistant authorship, not human independence, review approval or observed execution. Expected relationships are literal assertions. Native report TEXTs are not predicted or derived from implementation output: tests must independently invoke existing native APIs and compare preservation, while asserting these fixed relationships. Catalog cases are declarations, not inferred scenario links.
provenance.canonicalModelHash: Sorted JSON map keys and ID collections; sorted transition guards; effect order retained; formatVersion removed; no trailing LF. The unchanged original digest is cross-checked against the frozen manifest, not executed code.
